tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Window and card background. Every text token below is checked against it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Fill of text inputs, segmented-control tracks and chips at rest. Text on it: ink, ink-soft, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Quiet panels inside a window: the prompt read-out, the empty output panel. Text on it: ink, ink-soft, ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-sunken, surface-inset and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy that supports a heading, prompt text. On surface, surface-sunken, surface-inset.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints under controls, meta rows, rail hints. On surface, surface-sunken, surface-inset. The lightest grey allowed for text that carries meaning.

tokens.name: ink-hint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and decorative marks only (2.8:1 on surface in light, below the 4.5:1 text floor). Never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Window and card outlines. Decorative separation, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of secondary buttons and unselected chips. Decorative; controls are also told apart by fill and label.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections and under the footer.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action per view (Send), the selected segment and the selected rail item's mark. White (on-accent) text on it is 4.6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of accent controls. On-accent text on it is 5.9:1.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text or an icon: eyebrow, links, the selected chip's label, the selected rail item. On surface (5.9:1 light, 6.8:1 dark) and on accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chip and selected rail item background. Pair with accent-text and ink.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px. 4.6:1 or better against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved flash and positive status text, always with a word. On surface, surface-sunken, surface-inset.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a success banner or pill. Pair with success.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive text, always with a word. On surface and surface-inset.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner. Pair with danger.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Shortcut-conflict and account warnings, always with a word. On warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning banner. Pair with warning and ink.

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a warning banner.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled Send button. Its label uses ink-hint on purpose: disabled controls are exempt from the text floor.

tokens.name: illustration-sky
tokens.usage: Sky in the Reply and Write empty-state scenes. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-sea
tokens.usage: Sea body in the Reply and Write scenes. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-sea-far
tokens.usage: Band below the horizon in the Reply and Write scenes. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-sea-sunset
tokens.usage: Sea in the Ask scene. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-sand
tokens.usage: Sand in the Reply, Write and Understand scenes. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-sand-sunset
tokens.usage: Sand in the Ask scene. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-sand-shade
tokens.usage: Shadows on sand (the Ask scene uses #e6d0ae). Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-sunset-top
tokens.usage: Top of the Ask sky gradient. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-sunset-mid
tokens.usage: Middle of the Ask sky gradient. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-sunset-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the Ask sky gradient. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-sun
tokens.usage: Ask sun: a flat half disc on the horizon, no glow. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-sun-glint
tokens.usage: Sun reflection lines on the sea in the Ask scene. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-island
tokens.usage: Distant island in the Ask scene. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

tokens.name: illustration-silhouette
tokens.usage: Palm trunks and fronds in the Ask scene. Baked into the empty-state SVGs. Dark value is a placeholder equal to light until the designer supplies one; never invert.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Window and page titles, the mode title in the wide layout.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Rail items and tab strip labels (500 unselected, 700 selected in the strip).

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Text typed into fields and the output panel.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: Saves to Like Brit. in Settings

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above the rail. Set in uppercase.
styles.sample: WHAT ARE YOU TRYING TO DO?

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badges such as Edited. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard shortcut hints next to Send.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside inputs and panels, gap between rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of the popup.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Window padding on wide layouts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between the rail and the content column.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large breaks in settings pages.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and the Enabled badge.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Window and popup outer corners.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Panels, output panel, banners, rail items.

tokens.name: radius-inset
tokens.usage: Prompt read-out, intent field.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Text inputs and selects.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-seg
tokens.usage: Segments inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: Badges.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The floating popup window.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting panels. Almost invisible on purpose.

tokens.name: shadow-card-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers such as the Edit tabs popover.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: The selected knob in a segmented control or switch.

tokens.name: layout-rail-width
tokens.usage: Width of the mode rail on wide windows.

tokens.name: layout-rail-breakpoint
tokens.usage: Window content width at which the tab strip becomes the rail.

tokens.name: layout-popup-min-width
tokens.usage: Narrowest the popup may be resized to.

tokens.name: layout-popup-min-height
tokens.usage: Shortest the popup may be resized to.

tokens.name: layout-window-padding
tokens.usage: Padding around popup content on narrow layouts.

tokens.name: layout-control-height
tokens.usage: Send button and intent field height.
